text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, you clumsy fool! Apologizing isn't 
going to fix anything!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you put the experience you 
gained from working hard for King to good 
use in the future. Understood?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, don't think something like this will 
get me down. Resetting my mindset is 
first-rate too...!
It ended in a disappointing result...
